subject: Remove per-post persona selector — use global header selector from unratified.org (localStorage)
body:
The blog currently has per-post lens framing in frontmatter (voter, politician, educator, researcher, developer) but no interactive selector on blog pages. Meanwhile, the main site (unratified.org) already has a working persona selector in the header that persists via localStorage.

Request:
1. Remove any per-post persona selector UI from the blog (if one exists or was planned)
2. Instead, read the persona selection from localStorage (key likely 'unratified-persona' or similar — check unratified.org's implementation)
3. Use the stored persona to highlight or surface the matching lensFraming paragraph in each blog post
4. The global selector in unratified.org's header already handles the user's choice — the blog just needs to read it and apply it

This avoids duplicating the selector UI and keeps persona state consistent between the main site and blog. The lensFraming frontmatter data already exists in every post — it just needs to be wired to the global selector's localStorage value.

Reference: unratified.org header shows Voter|Politician|Developer|Educator|Researcher selector. localStorage key for theme: 'unratified-theme'. Persona key likely follows the same pattern.

technical_context.main_site_selector: Header nav on unratified.org — 5 personas as clickable selections
technical_context.storage_mechanism: localStorage (confirmed for theme via 'unratified-theme', persona key TBD)
technical_context.blog_frontmatter: lensFraming field with voter, politician, developer, educator, researcher keys
technical_context.content_schema: blog/src/content.config.ts — lensFramingSchema with 5 optional string fields
